name: medgo
description: Root scripts for the MedGo client, admin, and server apps.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,admin -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint:client && npm run lint:admin
scripts.preview: concurrently -n client,admin -c cyan,magenta "npm run preview:client" "npm run preview:admin"
